GET /A_RequestForQuotation: Gets the header details of all the requests for quotations in the system.
POST /A_RequestForQuotation: Creates a header of a new RFQ with the details passed in the request body.
GET /A_RequestForQuotation('{RequestForQuotation}'): Gets the header details of an RFQ.
PATCH /A_RequestForQuotation('{RequestForQuotation}'): Updates the header details of an RFQ.
DELETE /A_RequestForQuotation('{RequestForQuotation}'): Deletes an RFQ.
GET /A_RequestForQuotation('{RequestForQuotation}')/to_RequestForQuotationBidder: Gets the bidder details of an RFQ.
POST /A_RequestForQuotation('{RequestForQuotation}')/to_RequestForQuotationBidder: Adds bidder to an RFQ.
GET /A_RequestForQuotation('{RequestForQuotation}')/to_RequestForQuotationItem: Gets the item details from an RFQ.
POST /A_RequestForQuotation('{RequestForQuotation}')/to_RequestForQuotationItem: Adds an item to an RFQ.
GET /A_RequestForQuotationBidder: Gets all bidders from an RFQs.
POST /A_RequestForQuotationBidder: Adds one or several bidders to an RFQ.
GET /A_RequestForQuotationBidder(RequestForQuotation='{RequestForQuotation}',PartnerCounter='{PartnerCounter}'): Gets the bidder details of an RFQ by partner counter.
PATCH /A_RequestForQuotationBidder(RequestForQuotation='{RequestForQuotation}',PartnerCounter='{PartnerCounter}'): Updates the details of a bidder in an RFQ.
DELETE /A_RequestForQuotationBidder(RequestForQuotation='{RequestForQuotation}',PartnerCounter='{PartnerCounter}'): Deletes the bidder from the RFQ.
GET /A_RequestForQuotationItem: Gets the details of all items in all RFQs in the system.
POST /A_RequestForQuotationItem: Adds an item to an RFQ.
GET /A_RequestForQuotationItem(RequestForQuotationItem='{RequestForQuotationItem}',RequestForQuotation='{RequestForQuotation}'): Gets the item details of an RFQ.
PATCH /A_RequestForQuotationItem(RequestForQuotationItem='{RequestForQuotationItem}',RequestForQuotation='{RequestForQuotation}'): Updates the item details of in an RFQ.
DELETE /A_RequestForQuotationItem(RequestForQuotationItem='{RequestForQuotationItem}',RequestForQuotation='{RequestForQuotation}'): Deletes an item in an RFQ.
POST /Complete: Completes the bidding process.
POST /Cancel: Cancels the bidding process.
POST /SubmitForApproval: Submits RFQ for approval.
